usage: deskops doctor [-h] [--root ROOT] [--repair]

Check the desk and report two kinds of findings: errors, which break the desk
(exit 1), and alerts, which only mean the store moved under an expected change
(always printed, exit 0). Alerts are registered with `deskops desk update --apply`.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Target repository root.
  --repair     Attempt non-destructive repairs of errors; alerts are left
               alone.
